units.english: The minutes of the night wear on and, curious, you step out on your ship's boarding ramp to get a better view of your surroundings, to no avail. Despite this, you continue to wait. Eventually, after the night has worn on a little more, you hear the sound of water rushing; a small vehicle emerges from the lake and parks itself alongside your ship. A couple of Successors get out, one of whom approaches you.
units.italian: I minuti della notte passano e, incuriosito, scendi sulla rampa d'imbarco della nave per vedere meglio ciò che ti circonda, senza risultato. Ciò nonostante, continui ad aspettare. Alla fine, dopo che la notte è andata un po' più avanti, senti il rumore dell'acqua che si precipita; un piccolo veicolo emerge dal lago e si ferma accanto alla tua nave. Ne scendono un paio di Successori, uno dei quali si avvicina a te.

units.id: mission:Successors: Kaatrij First Contact 1|	"Captain <first> <last>," they say. Their voice sounds strange, like their words are being carried from a great distance on the wind; the sounds ripple and bend as they speak them.|779|0

units.italian: "Capitano <first> <last>," dicono. La loro voce suona strana, come se le loro parole fossero portate dal vento da molto lontano; i suoni ondeggiano e si piegano mentre le pronunciano.

units.id: mission:Successors: Kaatrij First Contact 1|	"That's right."|781|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Kaatrij First Contact 1|	"Who are you?"|782|0
units.english: "Who are you?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Kaatrij First Contact 1|	"Hmm. Good. I'm an envoy of the noble scions of House Kaatrij. I attest this myself as Saajret, of Somber Sejra." Saajret's skin erups with green splashes as they say this. "Thy lib'ral patience is well-appreciated." They splay their arms in the same manner as when you were first greeted by the Successors, and the two others behind them do so as well. "Ah," they continue, "but thou surely must be curious as to why we've called thee here. Thine actions, knowing or not, have benefited this noble House, and 'twould be craven fools to fail to recognize that fact. Prithee understand thee now that Raaqa-Uur-Kaav was our world and not Sioeora's. So too, the Kijran, ours, were never theirs to hold or grasp for."|783|0
units.english: "Hmm. Good. I'm an envoy of the noble scions of House Kaatrij. I attest this myself as Saajret, of Somber Sejra." Saajret's skin erups with green splashes as they say this. "Thy lib'ral patience is well-appreciated." They splay their arms in the same manner as when you were first greeted by the Successors, and the two others behind them do so as well. "Ah," they continue, "but thou surely must be curious as to why we've called thee here. Thine actions, knowing or not, have benefited this noble House, and 'twould be craven fools to fail to recognize that fact. Prithee understand thee now that Raaqa-Uur-Kaav was our world and not Sioeora's. So too, the Kijran, ours, were never theirs to hold or grasp for."
units.italian: "Hmm. Bene. Sono un inviato dei nobili eredi di Casa Kaatrij. Lo attesto io stesso come Saajret, di Somber Sejra." La pelle di Saajret erompe di schizzi verdi mentre lo dicono. "La tua liberale pazienza è molto apprezzata." Aprono i bracci nello stesso modo in cui ti avevano salutato i Successori la prima volta, e i due dietro di loro fanno lo stesso. "Ah," continuano, "ma devi certo essere curioso di sapere perché ti abbiamo chiamato qui. Le tue azioni, consapevoli o no, hanno giovato a questa nobile Casa, e saremmo vili sciocchi a non riconoscere il fatto. Sappi dunque che Raaqa-Uur-Kaav era il nostro mondo, non di Sioeora. E anche i Kijran, nostri, non sono mai stati loro da tenere o da ghermire."

units.id: mission:Successors: Kaatrij First Contact 1|	"So the Kijran belong to you?"|785|0
units.english: "So the Kijran belong to you?"
units.italian: "Quindi i Kijran appartengono a voi?"

units.english: "Can you tell me more about yourself?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Kaatrij First Contact 1|	"You mentioned earlier that the Kijran 'belong' to you?"|811|0
units.english: "You mentioned earlier that the Kijran 'belong' to you?"
units.italian: "Hai detto prima che i Kijran 'appartengono' a voi?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Kaatrij First Contact 1|	Saajret shivers with texture. "More than just 'belong to us,' 'tis true. The Kijran - Kiitaa and Khora alike - are our creations, bred and shaped as the hybrids of a dozen strains. Why was it that the life of our world endured while the life of the rest has long since perished, eroded by the harshness of the gravid void 'tween blasted stars? 'Twas the old House Kaatrij that strengthened their children against this decay. That we were forced to leave them behind was one among many sorrows, and 'tis much better thy quarry flies free than for another House to subject our charges to their whims.|818|0
units.english: Saajret shivers with texture. "More than just 'belong to us,' 'tis true. The Kijran - Kiitaa and Khora alike - are our creations, bred and shaped as the hybrids of a dozen strains. Why was it that the life of our world endured while the life of the rest has long since perished, eroded by the harshness of the gravid void 'tween blasted stars? 'Twas the old House Kaatrij that strengthened their children against this decay. That we were forced to leave them behind was one among many sorrows, and 'tis much better thy quarry flies free than for another House to subject our charges to their whims.
units.italian: Saajret freme di consistenza. "Più che solo 'appartengono a noi', è vero. I Kijran, Kiitaa e Khora ugualmente, sono creazioni nostre, allevate e plasmate come ibridi di una dozzina di ceppi. Perché la vita del nostro mondo è sopravvissuta mentre la vita del resto è da tempo perita, erosa dall'asprezza del vuoto gravido tra stelle devastate? Fu la vecchia Casa Kaatrij a rafforzare i loro figli contro questo decadimento. Che fossimo costretti a lasciarli indietro fu uno dei molti dolori, ed è molto meglio che la tua preda voli libera piuttosto che un'altra Casa sottoponga i nostri protetti ai suoi capricci.

units.id: mission:Successors: Kaatrij First Contact 1|	"Ah, there's that matter. Much as the High Houses might prefer to believe that they, or rather we, act all within the veil of secrecy, we're all too intertwined to keep our projects hidden for too long. The details of thine arrangement with Sioeora and its repercussions were apparent t'us soon after its conclusion. And surely too, will the details of this meeting eventually become apparent to the other Houses and their scions."|821|0
units.english: "Ah, there's that matter. Much as the High Houses might prefer to believe that they, or rather we, act all within the veil of secrecy, we're all too intertwined to keep our projects hidden for too long. The details of thine arrangement with Sioeora and its repercussions were apparent t'us soon after its conclusion. And surely too, will the details of this meeting eventually become apparent to the other Houses and their scions."
units.italian: "Ah, ecco quella faccenda. Per quanto le Casate Alte preferiscano credere che loro, o meglio noi, agiscano sempre sotto il velo della segretezza, siamo tutti troppo intrecciati perché i nostri progetti restino nascosti a lungo. I dettagli del tuo accordo con Sioeora e le sue ripercussioni ci sono stati chiari subito dopo la sua conclusione. E certo anche i dettagli di questo incontro diventeranno alla fine evidenti alle altre Casate e ai loro eredi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Kaatrij First Contact 1|	Saajret pauses for a moment to straighten some aspects of their clothing, before gesturing to a small wooden pin affixed to an outer layer of fabric. "We keep a number of these devices, full of sound and language, but very few for thine own tongue: this is the only one for which that we possess. I'm told it is an art piece, commissioned for a performance of thine own Shakespeare's Tempest so that our Predecessors could experience the work in its original form. 'Tis far too old and rare for it t'marry with our equipment; and so the need to contact thee in the words of another."|822|0
units.english: Saajret pauses for a moment to straighten some aspects of their clothing, before gesturing to a small wooden pin affixed to an outer layer of fabric. "We keep a number of these devices, full of sound and language, but very few for thine own tongue: this is the only one for which that we possess. I'm told it is an art piece, commissioned for a performance of thine own Shakespeare's Tempest so that our Predecessors could experience the work in its original form. units.italian: Saajret si ferma un momento per sistemare alcuni dettagli del proprio abito, poi indica una piccola spilla di legno fissata a uno strato esterno di tessuto. "Conserviamo diversi di questi dispositivi, pieni di suono e di lingua, ma pochissimi per la tua lingua: questo è l'unico che possediamo. Mi dicono che è un pezzo d'arte, commissionato per una rappresentazione della Tempesta del tuo Shakespeare, perché i nostri Predecessori potessero vivere l'opera nella sua forma originale. È troppo antico e raro perché si sposi con le nostre attrezzature; di qui la necessità di contattarti con le parole di un altro."

units.english: "'Tis a gift from House Kaatrij to thee, Captain," Saajret says. "Thou hast rendered service to this House, and in return we'll do the same for thee. So long as thou wear'st it, it shall translate our words to thee and thine to us. Pray treat it kindly, for it's unique enough that we cannot offer replacement." Saajret splays their arms again as if to emphasize the end of the statement.
units.italian: "È un dono di Casa Kaatrij a te, capitano," dice Saajret. "Hai reso servizio a questa Casa e, in cambio, faremo lo stesso per te. Finché lo indosserai, tradurrà le nostre parole a te e le tue a noi. Trattalo con cura, perché è abbastanza unico che non possiamo offrirne un sostituto." Saajret apre di nuovo i bracci, come per sottolineare la fine della frase.

units.italian: Saajret canticchia in un modo che non sai bene collocare. "Sioeora sarà senza dubbio contrariata che una delle Casate Nuove patrocini ora l'alieno che ha incontrato per prima, ma è abbastanza costretta a nuotare nell'acqua che ha salato da sé. Non dovresti temere la loro ira, al di là delle loro manovre politiche, e a convivere con quelle siamo abbastanza abituati."

units.id: mission:Successors: Kaatrij First Contact 1|	A wave of pink cascades along Saajret's arms before they reply. units.italian: Un'onda di rosa scende lungo i bracci di Saajret prima che rispondano. "Sono Saajret, onorato cittadino della nobile Casa Kaatrij, membro della sobria linea nobile di Casa Sejra, che più non sussiste se non come uno stendardo sotto le ali vigili di Kaatrij. Ah. Non tutte le nostre Casate sono sopravvissute alla caduta: Jaasii, Vejret, Ijridanii, Sejra e molte altre sono andate perdute per sempre, le loro famiglie disperse e le loro storie spezzate. Kaatrij ha assorbito i cittadini di alcune dentro di sé, e oggi è un mosaico che ci ricorda che siamo tutti mosaici, metamorfici e composti. I miei ruoli in essa sono molti, ma il primo tra loro è che sono una sorta di archivista. Conservo la vecchia tecnologia che ancora resta in nostro possesso e, quando serve, la metto in uso, nel modo migliore che giudichiamo possibile."

units.id: mission:Successors: Kaatrij First Contact 1|	Deciding that you've waited long enough, you activate the <ship>'s repulsor thrusters and return to orbit.|843|0
units.english: Deciding that you've waited long enough, you activate the <ship>'s repulsor thrusters and return to orbit.
units.italian: Decidi di aver aspettato abbastanza, attivi i propulsori repulsori della <ship> e torni in orbita.

units.id: mission:Successors: Kaatrij First Contact 1|	Saajret produces a data-sphere and hands that to you as well. "Within this," they say, "is historical data for most of the worlds within our space. Combined with thy newfound graces of our language, thou should'st find thine efforts of our worlds and cities t'be more revealing and fruitful. Officially, thou shalt be a patronized guest of House Kaatrij and shall proceed with our protection and our blessings. Thou may'st be able to purchase a certain set of petty works without frustration, but most of our technologies require vetting that, as an alien, may take thee time and effort to fulfill. Should'st the prospect interest thee, thine assistance with jobs and other tasks would doubtless help to prove thee t'be an ally to our people."|846|0
units.english: Saajret produces a data-sphere and hands that to you as well. "Within this," they say, "is historical data for most of the worlds within our space. Combined with thy newfound graces of our language, thou should'st find thine efforts of our worlds and cities t'be more revealing and fruitful. Should'st the prospect interest thee, thine assistance with jobs and other tasks would doubtless help to prove thee t'be an ally to our people."
units.italian: Saajret produce una sfera di dati e te la consegna. "Dentro questa," dicono, "ci sono i dati storici della maggior parte dei mondi del nostro spazio. Unita alla tua nuova padronanza della nostra lingua, dovresti trovare i tuoi sforzi sui nostri mondi e nelle nostre città più rivelatori e più fruttuosi. Ufficialmente sarai ospite patrocinato di Casa Kaatrij e procederai con la nostra protezione e le nostre benedizioni. Potrai forse acquistare una certa serie di opere minori senza difficoltà, ma la maggior parte delle nostre tecnologie richiede una verifica che, da alieno, potrebbe costarti tempo e fatica. Se la prospettiva ti interessa, il tuo aiuto in lavori e altri compiti contribuirebbe senza dubbio a dimostrare che sei un alleato del nostro popolo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Kaatrij First Contact 1|	Saajret pauses to adjust their clothing once again. "I must bid thee now farewell, Captain <first> <last>. Kaatrij will continue t'apprise ourselves of thine actions. I hope that next we speak shall be on equally positive terms." With this, Saajret and their escort return to the vehicle, which glides back into the lake. By the time that the <ship> is ready to take off, the ripples on the water have almost entirely dissipated and the first glimmers of sunlight are creeping over the distant hills.|847|0
units.english: Saajret pauses to adjust their clothing once again. "I must bid thee now farewell, Captain <first> <last>. Kaatrij will continue t'apprise ourselves of thine actions. I hope that next we speak shall be on equally positive terms." With this, Saajret and their escort return to the vehicle, which glides back into the lake. By the time that the <ship> is ready to take off, the ripples on the water have almost entirely dissipated and the first glimmers of sunlight are creeping over the distant hills.
units.italian: Saajret si ferma per sistemare ancora una volta il proprio abito. "Devo ora congedarmi, capitano <first> <last>. Kaatrij continuerà a tenersi informata delle tue azioni. Spero che la prossima volta in cui parleremo sia su termini altrettanto positivi." Detto questo, Saajret e la loro scorta tornano al veicolo, che scivola di nuovo nel lago. Quando la <ship> è pronta a decollare, le increspature sull'acqua si sono quasi del tutto dissipate e i primi bagliori del sole strisciano sulle colline lontane.

units.id: mission:Successors: Kaatrij First Contact 1|log|852|0
units.english: Summoned by the Successor High House Kaatrij to their homeworld, where it was explained that they are the ancestral keepers of the animals that I refused to capture for House Sioeora. Was rewarded for keeping the animals from Sioeora with a translation device and cultural data, which open up many of the Successors' worlds to me. Was told that assisting in jobs and missions for the Successors would eventually allow me to purchase some of their technology.
units.italian: Sei stato convocato dalla Casa Alta Kaatrij dei Successori sul loro mondo natale, dove ti è stato spiegato che sono i custodi ancestrali degli animali che avevi rifiutato di catturare per Casa Sioeora. Sei stato ricompensato per aver tenuto gli animali lontano da Sioeora con un dispositivo di traduzione e dati culturali, che ti aprono molti dei mondi dei Successori. Ti è stato detto che aiutare i Successori in lavori e missioni ti avrebbe alla fine permesso di acquistare parte della loro tecnologia.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|name|866|0
units.english: Meet the High Houses
units.italian: Incontra le Casate Alte

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|description|867|0
units.english: The High Houses are pleased with how you've conducted yourself in Successor space, and wish to meet with you in council to strengthen your relationship.
units.italian: Le Casate Alte sono compiaciute di come ti sei comportato nello spazio dei Successori, e desiderano incontrarti in consiglio per rafforzare il vostro rapporto.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|Soon after you set down in the spaceport here, you are approached by a group of Successors in naval uniforms, clearly and surprisingly in the employ of multiple various High Houses; there is some variance in the design of the uniforms of different members. Their leader addresses you in a calm tone with the unmistakable coolness that military officers seem to hold regardless of species, their skin remaining a flat gray throughout.|888|0
units.english: Soon after you set down in the spaceport here, you are approached by a group of Successors in naval uniforms, clearly and surprisingly in the employ of multiple various High Houses; there is some variance in the design of the uniforms of different members. Their leader addresses you in a calm tone with the unmistakable coolness that military officers seem to hold regardless of species, their skin remaining a flat gray throughout.
units.italian: Poco dopo essere atterrato nello spazioporto qui, ti si avvicina un gruppo di Successori in uniforme navale, chiaramente e sorprendentemente al servizio di diverse Casate Alte; c'è una qualche differenza nel disegno delle uniformi dei vari membri. Il loro capo si rivolge a te con tono calmo e con quella freddezza inconfondibile che gli ufficiali militari sembrano avere a prescindere dalla specie, la pelle che resta di un grigio piatto per tutto il tempo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"Captain <last>. The High Houses have noted thine actions in their space, and, wishing to make thee a stronger ally to their cause, have summoned thee to meet them in council. Thou art encouraged to make haste to the <system> system.|889|0
units.english: "Captain <last>. The High Houses have noted thine actions in their space, and, wishing to make thee a stronger ally to their cause, have summoned thee to meet them in council. Thou art encouraged to make haste to the <system> system.
units.italian: "Capitano <last>. Le Casate Alte hanno preso nota delle tue azioni nel loro spazio e, desiderando fare di te un alleato più forte alla loro causa, ti hanno convocato per incontrarle in consiglio. Sei invitato a fare in fretta verso il sistema <system>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"Thank you for telling me. I'll prepare to travel there immediately."|891|0
units.english: "Thank you for telling me. I'll prepare to travel there immediately."
units.italian: "Grazie per avermelo detto. Mi preparerò a partire subito."

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"What do you mean 'meet them in council?'"|893|0
units.english: "What do you mean 'meet them in council?'"
units.italian: "Che vuoi dire con 'incontrarle in consiglio'?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"The Houses often meet together t'determine what's t'be done about those things which matter to them all. Several del'gates of the High Houses hath gathered t'decide their plans for thee now that thou's proved thy usefulness and goodwill. More than that, I cannot say."|894|0
units.english: "The Houses often meet together t'determine what's t'be done about those things which matter to them all. Several del'gates of the High Houses hath gathered t'decide their plans for thee now that thou's proved thy usefulness and goodwill. More than that, I cannot say."
units.italian: "Le Casate si riuniscono spesso per determinare che cosa fare di quelle questioni che interessano a tutte. Diversi delegati delle Casate Alte si sono radunati per decidere i loro piani su di te, ora che hai dimostrato la tua utilità e la tua buona volontà. Più di questo, non posso dire."

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|log|902|0
units.english: Summoned to meet with the Successor High Houses in council and given the right to purchase their civilian technology.
units.italian: Sei stato convocato per incontrare in consiglio le Casate Alte dei Successori e ti è stato dato il diritto di acquistare la loro tecnologia civile.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|log|903|0
units.english: The High Houses are organized into two large alliances called the Old and New Houses, which have historically been in tension with each other. The Houses cooperate in council with their allies and the other Houses in general.
units.italian: Le Casate Alte sono organizzate in due grandi alleanze chiamate Casate Vecchie e Casate Nuove, storicamente in tensione tra loro. Le Casate cooperano in consiglio con i loro alleati e, in generale, con le altre Casate.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|Once you have sat down at the spaceport, you are met by another group of Successor naval officers. You notice that this group appears even more diverse than the last, representing several different uniform styles and liveries. Unifying them all is a small white and blue pin attached to their outfits; one that does not correspond to the insignia of any of the High Houses. The officers guide you, politely but firmly, to one of the monorail trains snaking out from the spaceport to other installations on the planet, and you all shuffle together into one of the cars, which appears to have been completely cleared of normal passengers, if it even carried those in the first place.|905|0
units.english: Once you have sat down at the spaceport, you are met by another group of Successor naval officers. You notice that this group appears even more diverse than the last, representing several different uniform styles and liveries. Unifying them all is a small white and blue pin attached to their outfits; one that does not correspond to the insignia of any of the High Houses. The officers guide you, politely but firmly, to one of the monorail trains snaking out from the spaceport to other installations on the planet, and you all shuffle together into one of the cars, which appears to have been completely cleared of normal passengers, if it even carried those in the first place.
units.italian: Dopo esserti seduto allo spazioporto, ti viene incontro un altro gruppo di ufficiali navali dei Successori. Noti che questo gruppo sembra ancora più vario del precedente, con diversi stili di uniforme e livree. A unirli tutti c'è una piccola spilla bianca e blu fissata ai loro abiti, che non corrisponde all'insegna di nessuna delle Casate Alte. Gli ufficiali ti guidano, con cortesia ma con fermezza, verso uno dei treni monorotaia che si snodano dallo spazioporto verso altri impianti del pianeta, e vi stipate tutti insieme in una delle carrozze, che sembra essere stata completamente sgomberata dai passeggeri normali, se mai ne ha portati.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	Several minutes later, the monorail deposits you at an especially large and well-decorated complex that swarms with both military and well-dressed civilians, some of whom appear so opulent and bejeweled that you suspect their personal effects are worth more than most starships. Each of them without exception wears the same white and blue insignia as your escorts, though many have incorporated it into their clothes' design or even display it as a pattern in skin coloration.|906|0
units.english: Several minutes later, the monorail deposits you at an especially large and well-decorated complex that swarms with both military and well-dressed civilians, some of whom appear so opulent and bejeweled that you suspect their personal effects are worth more than most starships. Each of them without exception wears the same white and blue insignia as your escorts, though many have incorporated it into their clothes' design or even display it as a pattern in skin coloration.
units.italian: Diversi minuti dopo, la monorotaia ti deposita in un complesso particolarmente grande e ben decorato, brulicante di militari e di civili ben vestiti, alcuni dei quali appaiono così opulenti e ingioiellati che sospetti che i loro effetti personali valgano più della maggior parte delle navi stellari. Ognuno di loro, senza eccezione, porta la stessa insegna bianca e blu delle tue scorte, anche se molti l'hanno incorporata nel disegno dei vestiti o addirittura la mostrano come motivo nella colorazione della pelle.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	As your escort peels off into the crowd, you see a familiar face in the distance: Sieasej, the Successor scholar, who visibly perks up when they see you and then approaches.|907|0
units.english: As your escort peels off into the crowd, you see a familiar face in the distance: Sieasej, the Successor scholar, who visibly perks up when they see you and then approaches.
units.italian: Mentre la tua scorta si disperde tra la folla, scorci in lontananza un volto familiare: Sieasej, lo studioso dei Successori, che si illumina visibilmente quando ti vede e poi si avvicina.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"Captain! Well-met again! Thou hast arrived at a fortunate hour, for there's still some minutes 'fore this day's meetings are scheduled to begin."|908|0
units.english: "Captain! Well-met again! Thou hast arrived at a fortunate hour, for there's still some minutes 'fore this day's meetings are scheduled to begin."
units.italian: "Capitano! Che bello incontrarti di nuovo! Sei arrivato in un'ora fortunata, perché mancano ancora alcuni minuti all'inizio delle riunioni di oggi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"We'd better get started, then."|911|0
units.english: "We'd better get started, then."
units.italian: "Meglio mettersi al lavoro, allora."

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"Can you explain what's going on here?"|913|0
units.english: "Can you explain what's going on here?"
units.italian: "Puoi spiegarmi che cosa succede qui?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"How has House Sioeora been?"|917|0
units.english: "How has House Sioeora been?"
units.italian: "Come sta Casa Sioeora?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"What are you doing here?"|921|0
units.english: "What are you doing here?"
units.italian: "Che cosa ci fai qui?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"This is a diplomatic world for envoys of the Houses to meet in council, resolve disputes, bicker, fight, and unify. And I suspect for thine own case, to offer special dispensation to useful citizens and patronized aliens."|928|0
units.english: "This is a diplomatic world for envoys of the Houses to meet in council, resolve disputes, bicker, fight, and unify. And I suspect for thine own case, to offer special dispensation to useful citizens and patronized aliens."
units.italian: "Questo è un mondo diplomatico dove gli inviati delle Casate si incontrano in consiglio, risolvono dispute, litigano, combattono e si uniscono. E sospetto che, nel tuo caso, serva a offrire dispense speciali a cittadini utili e ad alieni patrocinati."

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"Our mutual patrons remain their usual selves, with all that this entails. Would'st thou believe that Riijaaora themself informed me of thine invitation here? They've made themself a leader 'mong the others for their fruitful advocacy of thee... ah, but I digress. Let it suffice to say that Sioeora doubtless shall support thee here today, for thou'rt by now a successful investment on their part."|935|0
units.english: "Our mutual patrons remain their usual selves, with all that this entails. Would'st thou believe that Riijaaora themself informed me of thine invitation here? They've made themself a leader 'mong the others for their fruitful advocacy of thee... ah, but I digress. Let it suffice to say that Sioeora doubtless shall support thee here today, for thou'rt by now a successful investment on their part."
units.italian: "I nostri patroni reciproci restano quelli di sempre, con tutto ciò che ne consegue. Crederesti che Riijaaora in persona mi ha informato del tuo invito qui? Si sono fatti leader tra gli altri grazie alla loro fruttuosa difesa di te... ah, ma divago. Basti dire che Sioeora ti sosterrà senza dubbio qui oggi, perché ormai sei un investimento riuscito da parte loro."

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|label|937|0
units.english: sioeora opposed
units.italian: sioeora opposed

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"Ah, do they approve o'thy presence here and that?" Sieasej briefly examines a suckered arm before leaning in a little closer. "'Tis true the scions of my honored House remain towards thee a little chilly; and doubly so for thy finding of another patron which, I confess, may be what irks them most. Thou nonetheless remaineth a person of interest to them, and I suspect they'd be quite pleased to know that I'd encountered thee in council. So, let them brood, I say, for if Sioeora requires thee once more, they shan't be so knavish so's not to make thine acquaintance 'gain, methinks."|938|0
units.english: "Ah, do they approve o'thy presence here and that?" Sieasej briefly examines a suckered arm before leaning in a little closer. "'Tis true the scions of my honored House remain towards thee a little chilly; and doubly so for thy finding of another patron which, I confess, may be what irks them most. Thou nonetheless remaineth a person of interest to them, and I suspect they'd be quite pleased to know that I'd encountered thee in council. So, let them brood, I say, for if Sioeora requires thee once more, they shan't be so knavish so's not to make thine acquaintance 'gain, methinks."
units.italian: "Ah, approvano la tua presenza qui e il resto?" Sieasej esamina brevemente un braccio munito di ventose prima di chinarsi un po' più vicino. "È vero che gli eredi della mia onorata Casa restano verso di te un po' freddi; e doppiamente per il fatto che tu abbia trovato un altro patrono, che, confesso, è forse ciò che li irrita di più. Resti comunque una persona di interesse per loro, e sospetto che sarebbero piuttosto compiaciuti di sapere che ti ho incontrato in consiglio. Quindi, che rimugginino, dico io, perché se Sioeora avrà ancora bisogno di te, non saranno così villani da non farti di nuovo la tua conoscenza, credo."

units.italian: sioeora choice

units.italian: Sieasej diventa brevemente di una tonalità verde, in un'esibizione che potresti quasi definire un rossore. Mi è stato ordinato di parlare ad alcuni gruppi qui come sedicente esperto della materia."

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"Indeed. I'm ready to begin, then."|956|0
units.english: "Indeed. I'm ready to begin, then."
units.italian: "Infatti. Sono pronto a cominciare, allora."

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"How has House Sioeora been?"|958|0
units.english: "How has House Sioeora been?"
units.italian: "Come sta Casa Sioeora?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"Good! We'd be wise to be prompt in our arrival t'our events."|963|0
units.english: "Good! We'd be wise to be prompt in our arrival t'our events."
units.italian: "Bene! Faremmo bene a essere puntuali ai nostri appuntamenti."

The doors open to reveal a garden-like area, filled with large long-leafed plants surrounding a centrally-located depression half-filled with water. units.italian: Sieasej ti porta da una sorta di concierge, che alla fine ti informa che dovresti dirigerti verso una delle stanze più piccole che si diramano dalla hall. Le porte si aprono su una zona simile a un giardino, piena di grandi piante dalle foglie lunghe che circondano una depressione centrale riempita a metà d'acqua. Diversi Successori, molti vestiti bene come prima, sono riuniti nella vasca; non puoi fare a meno di sussultare un po' quando l'acqua gelida ti inonda gli stivali.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	After a few minutes and other Successors have trickled in, the meeting begins in earnest. One of the Successors moves to the center of the pool and addresses you directly.|967|0
units.english: After a few minutes and other Successors have trickled in, the meeting begins in earnest. One of the Successors moves to the center of the pool and addresses you directly.
units.italian: Dopo qualche minuto, mentre altri Successori sono entrati uno alla volta, la riunione comincia sul serio. Uno dei Successori si porta al centro della vasca e si rivolge direttamente a te.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"Captain. House Sioeora's supported thee with the gift of our device of tongues, and we continue t'recognize thy potential as an ally. We wish to further 'ppreciate the good that thou hast done upon our worlds, and we propose thou be awarded purchase rights for our petty technologies."|968|0
units.english: "Captain. House Sioeora's supported thee with the gift of our device of tongues, and we continue t'recognize thy potential as an ally. We wish to further 'ppreciate the good that thou hast done upon our worlds, and we propose thou be awarded purchase rights for our petty technologies."
units.italian: "Capitano. Casa Sioeora ti ha sostenuto con il dono del nostro dispositivo delle lingue, e continuiamo a riconoscere il tuo potenziale come alleato. Desideriamo apprezzare ulteriormente il bene che hai fatto sui nostri mondi, e proponiamo che ti siano concessi i diritti d'acquisto per le nostre tecnologie minori."

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	That representative then returns to the outer rim of the circle and another takes the center, this time facing the representative who just spoke.|969|0
units.english: That representative then returns to the outer rim of the circle and another takes the center, this time facing the representative who just spoke.
units.italian: Quel rappresentante torna poi al bordo esterno del cerchio e un altro prende il centro, questa volta rivolto al rappresentante che ha appena parlato.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"House Sioeora. House Chydiyi well sees thy perspicacity and, too, the value demonstrated by the captain, and so we support thy just proposal. The captain's proven themself t'be a benevolent traveler in our space, for whom we've every desire to make an ever more positive and useful element."|970|0
units.english: "House Sioeora. House Chydiyi well sees thy perspicacity and, too, the value demonstrated by the captain, and so we support thy just proposal. The captain's proven themself t'be a benevolent traveler in our space, for whom we've every desire to make an ever more positive and useful element."
units.italian: "Casa Sioeora. Casa Chydiyi vede bene la tua perspicacia e, anche, il valore dimostrato dal capitano, e quindi sosteniamo la tua giusta proposta. Il capitano si è dimostrato un viaggiatore benevolo nel nostro spazio, per il quale abbiamo ogni desiderio di renderlo un elemento sempre più positivo e utile."

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	A third representative now takes the center position, addressing the two previous speakers.|971|0
units.english: A third representative now takes the center position, addressing the two previous speakers.
units.italian: Un terzo rappresentante prende ora la posizione centrale, rivolgendosi ai due oratori precedenti.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"Noble Houses Sioeora and Chydiyi. House Kaatrij proposes this alien be given no further rights nor gifts until they have proved themself neutral. The Old Houses, which Sioeora and Chydiyi do today here represent, doth clearly seek to sway this alien's favor through brib'ry and deceit, t'exploit their lack of knowledge of our practices, and use them as they've already done to further their own interests in conflict with the common good."|972|0
units.english: "Noble Houses Sioeora and Chydiyi. House Kaatrij proposes this alien be given no further rights nor gifts until they have proved themself neutral. The Old Houses, which Sioeora and Chydiyi do today here represent, doth clearly seek to sway this alien's favor through brib'ry and deceit, t'exploit their lack of knowledge of our practices, and use them as they've already done to further their own interests in conflict with the common good."
units.italian: "Nobili Casate Sioeora e Chydiyi. Casa Kaatrij propone che a questo alieno non siano dati altri diritti né doni finché non avrà dimostrato di essere neutrale. Le Casate Vecchie, che Sioeora e Chydiyi oggi qui rappresentano, cercano chiaramente di piegare il favore di questo alieno con corruzione e inganno, di sfruttare la sua mancanza di conoscenza delle nostre usanze, e di usarlo come hanno già fatto per perseguire i propri interessi in conflitto con il bene comune."

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	That representative then returns to the edge of the circle, where they continue to eye you with suspicion. There is a pause in the conversation.|973|0
units.english: That representative then returns to the edge of the circle, where they continue to eye you with suspicion. There is a pause in the conversation.
units.italian: Quel rappresentante torna poi al bordo del cerchio, dove continua a fissarti con sospetto. C'è una pausa nella conversazione.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	(Remain silent.)|975|0

units.italian: (Resta in silenzio.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"I don't intend to take sides in your conflicts."|977|0
units.english: "I don't intend to take sides in your conflicts."
units.italian: "Non intendo schierarmi nei vostri conflitti."

There is no direct reply for some time until, after what seems like several minutes, the representative from House Kaatrij returns to the center and speaks.
units.italian: Questo suscita un mormorio tra i Successori riuniti, sia i rappresentanti stessi sia gli altri membri più silenziosi che continuano a stare intorno al perimetro della vasca. Non c'è risposta diretta per un po', finché, dopo quelli che sembrano diversi minuti, il rappresentante di Casa Kaatrij torna al centro e parla.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"Guest. House Kaatrij shall recognize thy noble words, even if we hold no reason for belief in them. We will permit the others to let thee buy our trinkets, and we shall watch thee closely to see if thy words are matched in action."|996|0
units.english: "Guest. House Kaatrij shall recognize thy noble words, even if we hold no reason for belief in them. We will permit the others to let thee buy our trinkets, and we shall watch thee closely to see if thy words are matched in action."
units.italian: "Ospite. Casa Kaatrij riconoscerà le tue nobili parole, anche se non abbiamo motivo di credervi. Permetteremo agli altri di lasciarti acquistare le nostre cianfrusaglie, e ti osserveremo da vicino per vedere se le tue parole corrispondono ai fatti."

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	With no further comments from any of the Successors, the representative from House Sioeora calls for a vote from among the gathered representatives. Sioeora and Chydiyi vote for the proposition and Kaatrij abstains from the vote, remaining at the rim of the pool, inspecting your behavior closely. The representative from Sioeora then promptly produces another small box from within their outfit and presents it to you. You open it to reveal one of the pin insignias that you have seen throughout this meeting.|997|0
units.english: With no further comments from any of the Successors, the representative from House Sioeora calls for a vote from among the gathered representatives. Sioeora and Chydiyi vote for the proposition and Kaatrij abstains from the vote, remaining at the rim of the pool, inspecting your behavior closely. The representative from Sioeora then promptly produces another small box from within their outfit and presents it to you. You open it to reveal one of the pin insignias that you have seen throughout this meeting.
units.italian: Senza altri commenti da parte dei Successori, il rappresentante di Casa Sioeora chiede un voto tra i rappresentanti riuniti. Sioeora e Chydiyi votano a favore della proposta e Kaatrij si astiene, restando al bordo della vasca a osservare attentamente il tuo comportamento. Il rappresentante di Sioeora produce poi subito un'altra piccola scatola dall'interno del proprio abito e te la presenta. L'apri e trovi una delle spille-insegna che hai visto durante tutta questa riunione.

Thou surely can'st remain a neutral party while thy patron already seeks to honor thee before this council, t'offer boons that surely curry favor soon enough. Thy meager words make little difference."
units.italian: "Alieno. Casa Sioeora ascolta bene le tue parole, ma deve impegnarsi in opposizione a questa proposta di dono. Non puoi certo restare una parte neutrale mentre il tuo patrono cerca già di onorarti davanti a questo consiglio, offrendo benefici che di certo guadagneranno favore abbastanza presto. Le tue magre parole fanno poca differenza."

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"'Tis is the mark of our diplomats and our symbol of trust and cooperation," they say. units.english: "'Tis is the mark of our diplomats and our symbol of trust and cooperation," they say. "Our people may remain wary of an alien in their midst, but wherever thou displays this, it shall be known thou hast received the blessing of the High Houses in our council and that they may trade with you in amity and without fear."
units.italian: "È il segno dei nostri diplomatici e il nostro simbolo di fiducia e cooperazione," dicono. "La nostra gente potrà restare diffidente verso un alieno in mezzo a lei, ma ovunque tu mostri questo, si saprà che hai ricevuto la benedizione delle Casate Alte nel nostro consiglio e che possono commerciare con te in amicizia e senza timore."

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	With this, Chydiyi then leaves the room, followed by most of the other representatives and gathered members, the remainder of whom begin to mingle amongst themselves and chat; the meeting is apparently over.|1009|0
units.english: With this, Chydiyi then leaves the room, followed by most of the other representatives and gathered members, the remainder of whom begin to mingle amongst themselves and chat; the meeting is apparently over.
units.italian: Detto questo, Chydiyi lascia la stanza, seguita dalla maggior parte degli altri rappresentanti e dei membri riuniti, e i restanti cominciano a mescolarsi tra loro e a chiacchierare; la riunione è evidentemente finita.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	Outside, you run into Sieasej again, who has recently come back from a meeting of their own. "Well, captain, how went thy meeting in council? 'Twas fruitful, I hope?"|1010|0
units.english: Outside, you run into Sieasej again, who has recently come back from a meeting of their own. "Well, captain, how went thy meeting in council? 'Twas fruitful, I hope?"
units.italian: Fuori, ti imbatti di nuovo in Sieasej, appena tornato da una riunione propria. "Bene, capitano, come è andata la tua riunione in consiglio? Fruttuosa, spero?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"Yes, I was awarded technology purchase rights."|1012|0
units.english: "Yes, I was awarded technology purchase rights."
units.italian: "Sì, mi sono stati concessi i diritti di acquisto della tecnologia."

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"Yes, it was. How was yours?"|1013|0
units.english: "Yes, it was. How was yours?"
units.italian: "Sì, lo è stata. E la tua?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"I, for one, am pleased to hear of this, captain. The Houses can be jealous with their favors, but in thy case I think they're wise for dispensing them more liberally. Ah," they say, interrupting themself, "would that I could stay, but yet my role here's still to finish and I've another meeting still to entertain. Fair travels, captain, and may we meet again." They splay their arms wide in the same gesture you've seen many times before and you offer a short bow in return.|1015|0
units.english: "I, for one, am pleased to hear of this, captain. The Houses can be jealous with their favors, but in thy case I think they're wise for dispensing them more liberally. Ah," they say, interrupting themself, "would that I could stay, but yet my role here's still to finish and I've another meeting still to entertain. Fair travels, captain, and may we meet again." They splay their arms wide in the same gesture you've seen many times before and you offer a short bow in return.
units.italian: "Io, per parte mia, sono lieto di sentirlo, capitano. Le Casate possono essere gelose dei loro favori, ma nel tuo caso credo che siano sagge a dispensarli con più liberalità. Ah," dicono, interrompendosi, "vorrei poter restare, ma il mio ruolo qui non è ancora finito e ho un'altra riunione da seguire. Buon viaggio, capitano, e che possiamo incontrarci di nuovo." Aprono i bracci in un gesto ampio che hai visto molte volte, e tu rispondi con un breve inchino.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	"I'm pleased to hear this, captain. I spoke at length about my research on thy words and his'try, as we know it. Ah, thy tongues are fascinating items and make for truly interesting sounds... 'Twas also that I entertained a number of questions about thee thyself! Some young archivist from Kaatrij, methinks? Truthfully, I sometimes confuse those New Houses with each other. Ah," they say, interrupting themself, "but yet my role here's still to finish and I've another meeting still to entertain. Fair travels, captain, and may we meet again." They splay their arms wide in the same gesture you've seen many times before and you offer a short bow in return.|1018|0
units.english: "I'm pleased to hear this, captain. I spoke at length about my research on thy words and his'try, as we know it. Ah, thy tongues are fascinating items and make for truly interesting sounds... 'Twas also that I entertained a number of questions about thee thyself! Some young archivist from Kaatrij, methinks? Truthfully, I sometimes confuse those New Houses with each other. Ah," they say, interrupting themself, "but yet my role here's still to finish and I've another meeting still to entertain. Fair travels, captain, and may we meet again." They splay their arms wide in the same gesture you've seen many times before and you offer a short bow in return.
units.italian: "Sono lieto di sentirlo, capitano. Ho parlato a lungo della mia ricerca sulle tue parole e sulla storia, come la conosciamo. Ah, le tue lingue sono oggetti affascinanti e producono suoni davvero interessanti... Mi sono anche intrattenuto su diverse domande su di te! Qualche giovane archivista di Kaatrij, credo? A dire il vero, a volte confondo quelle Casate Nuove tra loro. Ah," dicono, interrompendosi, "ma il mio ruolo qui non è ancora finito e ho un'altra riunione da seguire. Buon viaggio, capitano, e che possiamo incontrarci di nuovo." Aprono i bracci in un gesto ampio che hai visto molte volte, e tu rispondi con un breve inchino.

units.id: mission:Successors: Trusted|	With your meeting resolved here, you head back to the monorail station and catch the next train back to the spaceport.|1024|0
units.english: With your meeting resolved here, you head back to the monorail station and catch the next train back to the spaceport.
units.italian: Con la tua riunione qui conclusa, torni alla stazione della monorotaia e prendi il treno successivo per lo spazioporto.
